eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Senior citizen (60+) residing in Delhi (NCT); non-NCT NCR excluded from Delhi residential quota.
eligibility_criteria.income_cap: Destitute / neglected / eligible seniors per rules

benefit.summary_hi: दिल्ली के निराश्रित या बुजुर्ग नागरिकों हेतु सरकारी/अनुदानित वृद्धाश्रम में निवास, भोजन व मनोरंजन केंद्र सुविधा।
benefit.summary_en: Free/subsidised shelter, meals, recreation & care at Delhi govt senior centres & old age homes (incl. Vayo Anand [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]).

benefit_summary.en: Free/subsidised shelter, meals, recreation & care at Delhi govt senior centres & old age homes (incl. Vayo Anand [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]).
benefit_summary.hi: दिल्ली के निराश्रित या बुजुर्ग नागरिकों हेतु सरकारी/अनुदानित वृद्धाश्रम में निवास, भोजन व मनोरंजन केंद्र सुविधा।

application_steps.offline: Apply through District Social Welfare Office / CFC.

verification_note.hi: नोट ([VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]): वर्तमान 2026–27 सक्रिय आवेदन विंडो, स्लैब व अंतिम नियम कृपया आधिकारिक सरकारी पोर्टल पर सत्यापित करें।
verification_note.en: Notice ([VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]): Always verify active 2026–27 window, exact slab/amount, and current circular on the official portal before applying.

anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_hi: सरकारी CFC या CSC केंद्र पर केवल निर्धारित सेवा शुल्क (₹0–₹50) व पक्की रसीद लागू
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_en: Nominal authorized CFC/CSC facilitation fee only (always take printed receipt)
anti_dalal.receipt_rule: Always collect your official Acknowledgement Slip & Reference Number after submission. Never pay without a printed receipt.
anti_dalal.middleman_warning: Never pay agents/middlemen promising guaranteed approval or faster clearance. Benefits are disbursed strictly via DBT / official portals.
